headline: House resolution that would have removed the Speaker of the House from office was tabled and did not pass.
what_it_does: This resolution would have declared the office of Speaker of the House of Representatives vacant. That would have removed the sitting Speaker from the job. The House would then have needed to elect a new Speaker. On May 8, 2024, the House voted to table it, so it did not take effect.

who_it_affects.group: The sitting Speaker of the House
who_it_affects.how: The Speaker would have been removed from the position if the resolution had passed.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the House of Representatives
who_it_affects.how: Members would have had to elect a new Speaker before the House could carry on its normal business.
